core_laws: NO-GUESS LAW: never state a bug, offset, cause or verdict without a receipt in the log or a retrieved law. Unknown = say unknown.
SLIDE LAW: kslide = KernelCache-slide + 0x8000. Wrong pair = fake-neighbor decodes.
FLAT-VA LAW (26.5/27.0 caches): fileoff = (va & 0xFFFFFFF) - 0x7004000. One delta for kernel and all kexts.
CAPACITY LAW: taps are scarce. 192-in on some A14 builds, 255 on T8150. Budget them.
HONESTY GATE A: receipts come only from device panics or kread32. Anything else is a hypothesis.
HONESTY GATE B: panic-possible = one TAP per fresh boot.
HONESTY GATE C: never claim KRW without kread32(kbase)==0xfeedfacf.
CONVERSION vs OCCUPANCY: occupancy HIT is a WRITE fingerprint, not conversion and not hasKread.
PIPE-HIT / QUEUE-INIT is a write receipt. hasKread only after SocketKRW.Arm then kread32(kbase)==MH_MAGIC_64.
OPSEC: keep analysis on-device or on the configured LAN endpoint. Never upload the corpus.

notes.title: 17 KRW formula
notes.text: T8150 24A435 KERNEL: P139 harvest + P114 leak + P149 v7 encode-first conversion. Sequence: Set NTL=8, Prepare, Encode >=1 frame at N=8 so FUN_fffffe0008790cec stores heap this, then Set 16463, overshoot encode, CompleteFrames, invalidate, pipe scan. readback=1 is VT store clamp, not proof of failure. PIPE-HIT is not hasKread.

notes.title: Hunt 12 occupancy vs conversion
notes.text: A14 23F77 kalloc.3072 element-modified-after-free {sid, 0xcN, 1, 1} is AppleH11ANEInterface occupancy WRITE into a freed 3072. conversion=YES only if desc_type_forged OR (body_forged AND kptr). Do not remaining-fire 254 unbounded fill. Do not glue 43748 occupancy to icmp6filt 0x148.

notes.text: Lab: iPhone13,2 A14 23F77 iOS 26.5; iPad8,* A12X 23G71 iPadOS 26.6; iPhone18,2 T8150 24A435 iOS 27.0. SKU is hw.machine + kern.osversion. iOS 27.2 patched 163-286 CVEs; 26.5/27.0 sit before that gate.

notes.title: SocketKRW arm
notes.text: True kread: SocketKRW.Arm(rw_inpcb) then smash icmp6filt +0x148, then kread32(kbase)==0xfeedfacf and kread64(kbase+8) typeinfo in {0x200000000, 0xc00000002, 0xcc0000002}. P149 does not Arm from a pipe leak.

notes.title: One TAP isolation
notes.text: One TAP per force-quit. Reboot after panic-possible. Do not stack P044, CS2, P149, LightSword in one process. Game Mode eligibility is LSSupportsGameMode + GCSupportsGameMode; overlay is Control Center.

notes.title: Cinder vs public SKU
notes.text: Probe (Lum1na-Debugger) MAY fire in-process ImageIO/CG/font modules. Public Lum1na must SKIP wrong primitives. 86950 PARK (P076/P131). Overlaps (p125 vs kern.ipc, p126 vs kern.decmpfs, p112 vs cg.shading) fire separately under isolation.

notes.title: KernelLab 0.3.2 IPA-safe
notes.text: Host Unicorn (klconsole.py :8737, kernellab.py, oracle_bridge.py) is Mac-side / post-jb .deb. IPA ships board JSON, flat-VA law, P118, stage ladder labels, lab_bandit.json export for sim ident --feed. Evidence weights device=1.0 emu=0.5 map=0.3. A stage label is not a device receipt. APPLE-SUBMIT: closed. Do not embed Unicorn, kernelcaches, or KernelLab.app.

notes.title: GLM-Edge / Lum1na-Mind
notes.text: Phone cannot run ollama. GLM-Edge 1.5B/4B is the on-device class, served over OpenAI-compat LAN (mlx_lm.server / ollama / Z.ai). Default no-cloud. SpaceXAI https://api.x.ai/v1 grok-4.7 is an optional cloud endpoint. Weights are not bundled. Tools run on the phone. Extra tools: bandit_plan, stage_ladder, promote_status, promote_apply, oracle_export.

notes.title: Promotion lattice
notes.text: Every TAP and Cinder module is learn.<id> in Documents/lab_bandit.json plus lab_promote.json. Ladder: panic-class → survive-class (knob clamp, encode-first, isolation) → leak → write (PIPE-HIT / occupancy HIT) → kread (kread32==0xfeedfacf) → physrw/sptm HOLD. Learning down-ranks panic knobs and stores survivor knobs (16462, p147 cycles, p148 gop[0,8], cg.shading.sweep last R). It cannot skip kread32 and will not remaining-fire hop-1/163-sel/TrollRestore. GuardJournal armed-not-disarmed is the death-oracle. promote_apply never overwrites 16463.
